title: Constant-section coordinates and operations before three-index coherence
statement: For every prime ell and finite extension E of Q_ell, there exist Base b and Operations o on the actual ell-power strict quotient towers [def-sp-tower-shriek-data]. For every scheme T, there is SemilinearDerivedSectionsData s on its actual coefficient sheaves and adjacent quotient maps whose systems field equals b.calculus T [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. This asserts coordinate and operation existence only; it does not assert scalar/tensor composition or coefficient-mate composition.

source.place: (2), transposes of the units and counits, tensor associativity, and evaluation to finite maps

proof.text: Apply strictBaseCoordinates. The ramification equation, quotient finiteness, additive identity-on-sections rebundling and the retained semilinear derived-sections calculi are constructed there; retain the same Base b and witnesses s.

Apply strictGeometricCoordinates to b to obtain the geometric family and its ordinary inverse-image compositor, with the evaluation equation for its exact termwise localization. Define Operations.comp to be precisely that localization; comp_termwise is reflexivity.

For every open immersion apply strictOpenTensorCoordinates to that particular geometry. Retain its Open record. Form the specified tensor-unit inverse-pullback arrow and transpose through its actual derived open adjunction; this arrow is invertible. Define openTensor as the inverse of asIso of that transpose. The homEquiv apply_symm_apply identity proves openTensor_mate. Assemble Operations and retain the base calculus witnesses.

proof_origin.place: (2): explicit base construction; geometric transport and open-support steps isolated; operations assembled by exact localization and the specified invertible adjunction transpose.

theorem strictCoordinatesExistence :
    ∃ b : Base l E, ∃ _o : Operations l E b,
      ∀ T : Scheme.{u},
        ∃ s : SemilinearSections.SemilinearDerivedSectionsData.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
          (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (B l E T) (tau l E T),
          s.systems = b.calculus T
